rationale: This revised plan addresses all three feedback items from the evaluation. First, group_comparison.min_group_size is raised from 0 to 30 to flag groups with fewer than 30 claims as statistically unstable, implementing the statistical discipline feedback (T3-min_group_size). Second, the write_report caveats now include 'small_groups' to document that rates for small groups are unstable, addressing the communication feedback (T3-caveat_small_groups). Third, 'association_not_causation' is added to clarify that observed group differences represent associations, not causal effects (T3-caveat_association). The three evolved skills remain applicable: adjudicated_claims denominator choice ensures valid segment-level rate comparisons; synthetic_data and descriptive_only caveats protect reader interpretation. All task requirements are satisfied.
changes_summary: Increased group_comparison.min_group_size from 0 to 30 to flag unstable small groups. Added 'small_groups' and 'association_not_causation' caveats to write_report.
